title: Australia, New Zealand and Canada (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Rozwiaz zadania (1.1.-1.4.), udzielajac odpowiedzi w jezyku angielskim. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc merytoryczna i jezykowa odpowiedzi. W zadaniach za 2 punkty nalezy wpisac dwie odpowiedzi - kazda w osobnym polu.

items.question: What is the capital city of Australia, and which Australian city has the largest population?
What are the indigenous people of New Zealand called, and what is the name of the ceremonial dance performed by the national rugby team?
Which leaf is the national symbol shown on the flag of Canada?
What is the name of the world's largest coral reef system, off the north-east coast of Australia?
